mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.product_id, p.title AS product_title, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = r.product_id ORDER BY pi.is_cover DESC, pi.sort ASC LIMIT 1) AS product_image, r.buyer_id, bu.account AS buyer_name, bu.avatar AS buyer_avatar, r.seller_id, su.account AS seller_name, r.rating, r.content, r.reply_content, r.reply_time, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM product_review r LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN base_user bu ON r.buyer_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN base_user su ON r.seller_id = su.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) FROM product_review r WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_review r WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.status = 1
